about_the_game:
My Last 20 is a frenetic arcade game where you have to avoid being hit by asteroids in the deep space for ONLY 20 SECONDS!! Sound easy right?... Well ask the 200.000 more dead astronauts that tried this before...

Come out alive from this mission avoiding all the asteroids, cows, stranted aliens and unalive space monster parts by moving the cool looking astronaut at lightning speed, your reflexes and survival instincts will be put on the test.

- Retro Cool graphics:

Your eyes will be blast with cool graphics, vibrand colors and nostalgic look with this game.

- Collect, Changes Gear, Repeat.

Extract from the chaos zone Space Tokens and exchange them for amazing skins with unique VFXs and animations.

- Become a master

Play in the arcade mode where you can surpass the 20 seconds mark and keep accumulating seconds to your reckless personal record, you can also use the power ups to help that personal record shine!

- Be the BEST ASTRONAUT

Show of your deaths..... I mean... your survival seonds with other astronauts and don't be a "bottom frag".

-WARNING-

Flashing lights
